data.long_description:
Presenting this exceptional 5-bedroom villa in Al Habtoor Polo Resort Residences, Dubailand. Offering expansive space and refined design, this home is ideal for families seeking a prestigious address within a serene, resort-style community.

Spanning an impressive 7,371.34 sq.ft, the villa features 5 spacious bedrooms and 6 bathrooms, thoughtfully designed to provide maximum comfort, privacy, and functionality. The layout includes generous living and dining areas, complemented by large windows that bring in abundant natural light and enhance the sense of space.

The property boasts a modern kitchen, well-proportioned bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, and high-quality finishes throughout. The outdoor space offers excellent potential for relaxation and entertaining, set within a peaceful environment surrounded by greenery.

Property Features:

5 Bedrooms
6 Bathrooms
Size: 7,371.34 sq.ft

Bright interiors with natural light
Built-in wardrobes
Premium finishes

Community Highlights:

Polo and equestrian lifestyle

Located in Dubailand, Al Habtoor Polo Resort Residences offers a unique blend of luxury, privacy, and accessibility—perfect for discerning homeowners and investors.
